quotes.text: Festivals remind us that joy is better when shared.
Light a lamp, share a sweet, and spread a smile.
May this festive season fill your home with love and laughter.
Celebrations are the colours that brighten the calendar of life.
Every festival is a reason to come together as family.
Wishing you light, prosperity and peace this festive season.
Traditions connect our hearts to our roots.
Celebrate today, create memories for a lifetime.
